scope: Relevant full sections were read; target-specific primary curation and expanded terminal variants remain in progress.

references.title: Lipoproteins and Their Trafficking to the Outer Membrane.
references.review_notes: Full opening maturation/diversity section and transition to THE Lol PATHWAY read. Supports the ordered precursor-processing boundary and lineage-variable products. Predates LnsAB, Lnb and LhaT discovery; its statement that their enzymology remains unknown is historical. The Lgt linkage is a thioether: the review uses thioester in one sentence, which is not adopted here. No universal essentiality inference is made.

references.title: Leveraging the lipoprotein trafficking pathway for the development of novel antimicrobials.
references.review_notes: Full Section 2, Lipoproteins - Gram-negatives and Gram-positives, read. Used for E. coli canonical processing and the downstream trafficking boundary. The extrapolation to universal Gram-negative enzyme conservation is not adopted: primary PMID39495918 establishes non-orthologous Lnb. General statements about Gram-positive nonessentiality are not transferred to each target.

references.title: Bacterial Surfaces and Barriers: Biogenesis and Pathogen-Host Interactions.
references.review_notes: Full Section 2.2.3, IM Lipoprotein Biogenesis, read. Supports shared Lgt/LspA chemistry and species-dependent terminal modification. Its phrase third modification is not interpreted as adding a third acyl chain for Lit; primary isotope/reconstitution studies establish intramolecular relocation. Broad species essentiality statements are not used to assign target phenotypes.

lgt_diacylglyceryl_transfer_step: Section 2.2.3 describes phosphatidylglycerol-derived diacylglyceryl transfer to the precursor cysteine, preceding LspA cleavage. This is shared chemistry, not a universal essentiality claim.
lspa_signal_peptide_cleavage_step: The maturation section places signal-peptide removal after lipidation, exposing the amino terminus; monoderm product diversity and diderm Lol trafficking are separate dimensions.
lnt_n_acylation_step: Section 2 supports the canonical E. coli Lgt-LspA-Lnt route to triacylated lipoprotein. This statement does not grant Lnt orthology or identical terminal chemistry to all bacteria.

limits: 2019 Lgt thioester wording is not adopted; linkage is thioether.
No universal Lnt or essentiality inference from broad review prose.
Lit changes acyl position without adding a third acyl group.
